posts.name: Decision Desk HQ
posts.text:
DECISION DESK HQ RATINGS UPDATE (10/19): Senate

Democrats: 56%
Republicans: 44%

Democrats remain favored to flip the Senate. 

They need to flip four seats to win control - our model currently forecasts Democrats to flip Alaska, Maine, North Carolina, and Texas.

posts.name: Nate Silver
posts.text: I started following politics seriously in 2006 and since then there's only been one election cycle, 2012, that went well for the president's party. 2022 probably a distant second but closer to "not badly" than "well".

posts.name: Decision Desk HQ
posts.text:
DDHQ FORECAST UPDATE (10/19)

FL-22: Tossup -> Leans R
GA-7: Likely R -> Safe R
MI-10: Toss Up -> Leans D

Democrats now have a 77% probability of flipping the House.

In our latest forecast update, Democrats are favored in 235 seats; 218 seats are needed for a majority.
